findings.summary: Round1 forbidden outputs are omitted from the closed-world absence coverage.
evidence: The policy declares three forbidden Round1 outputs: closure manifest, external anchor, and external attestation.
The rejected-output union contains 19 paths, but admissionCoverage classifies only 16; all three Round1 paths are missing.
The snapshot omits these paths, and the checker enforces absence only for snapshot.absentPaths, so planting any of them would not invalidate review_pre_transition.

findings.summary: P107A can be marked completed while declared completion artifacts remain intentionally absent.
evidence: CD03A completionArtifacts includes rejected Round3, Round4, and Round5 manifests, attestations, and receipts that the same policy classifies as rejected_output_absent.
The preserved program checker requires every completionArtifact to be a regular file once a workstream is completed.
V6 governance checks only completionArtifact path syntax and the lifecycle tuple; an in-memory anchored_planned state passed with zero governance errors despite the missing artifacts.
The staged program:check replaces the preserved program checker with a diagnostic-only harness, leaving no authoritative completion-artifact existence enforcement.
